items.q: And there was a -- I think a fellow named Norman

ctx.x: And they had -- they had very spectacular shows, costumes and chorus girls and dancers and singers. And there was a -- I think a fellow named Norman
Thomas, he was the best of producers of shows, night club shows, in Chicago at that time. He had the most spectacular shows of any producer in Chicago, during that time.
